title: 从低配到超配：外资为何突然转向美国市场，盈利扩散带来新机会
speaker: John Woods

segments.en: I was going to get to the equity story to your point. I think since you last, we last spoke at least, you guys have changed the call on you as equities. You're no longer underweight. Help us understand what.
segments.zh: 我正想谈股市行情。自从我们上次交谈以来，你们改变了对美国股市的看法。不再低配。请帮助我们理解原因。

segments.en: It was a function of price falling. Was it something else in that call? Look, it was really a function of Q2 earnings.
segments.zh: 是因为价格下跌吗？还是有其他原因？实际上，这主要归因于第二季度盈利。

segments.en: Well, Q2 earnings, as it became quite apparent, have started to broaden, have started to deepen. No longer is it a narrow thematic around AI and US exceptionalism.
segments.zh: 第二季度盈利明显开始扩散和深化。不再仅仅是围绕AI和美国例外主义的狭窄主题。

segments.en: Actually, it's more of a cyclical story now, David. And what we were really quite deriving optimism was the fact that we are seeing CapEx now expanding outside of the AI story.
segments.zh: 实际上，现在更多是周期性故事，大卫。我们真正乐观的是，我们看到资本开支正在AI故事之外扩张。

segments.en: So this is leading to a more broadening growth or a more broadening macro story. And it's our view that as this non-AI CapEx proliferates, particularly amongst the smaller midcap style of the market, we will start to get a more sustainable equity story.
segments.zh: 这导致了更广泛增长或更广泛的宏观故事。我们认为，随着非AI资本开支扩散，尤其是在中小盘股中，我们将看到更可持续的股市行情。

segments.en: And that's what has led us to that overweight position. And you're upgrading Taiwan equities as well. What's the rationale behind that?
segments.zh: 这就是我们转为超配的原因。你们还上调了台湾股市评级。背后的理由是什么？

segments.en: I mean, more broadly, it's a leverage play on, it's a sector play, if you will, on tech, on semis. And we think that because this story, in our view, has many, many years to run,
segments.zh: 更广泛地说，这是对科技和半导体的杠杆化行业配置。我们认为这个故事还有多年发展空间。

segments.en: we try and strategically enter Taiwan on dips on opportunities. It's an opportunistic trade, same with South Korea. And in our view, there is alpha.
segments.zh: 我们试图在台湾市场回调时战略性地介入。这是机会性交易，韩国也是如此。我们认为存在超额收益。

segments.en: There is returns to be had in playing this leverage sector story in Asia. What about the momentum factor? This momentum? I mean, terrible July, so we're still trying to figure out what the damage was from the drop in July.
segments.zh: 在亚洲利用这一杠杆行业故事可以获得回报。那么动量因子呢？七月表现糟糕，我们仍在评估七月下跌造成的损失。
